description: Initial departments, positions, and permission assignments for the Agora incumbent migration. Mirrors a typical public administration org chart so an existing PA can map its staff 1-to-1. Seeded as real Department organizations (policy, fund, permissions, Position seats, staff invite codes) by init.py — see issue #241. Policies start founder-friendly because a fresh realm has few members; each department declares a target_policy (5-of-10) that admins ratchet up in Organizations once the seats are staffed. Position salary_amount is per salary_period in the realm's accounting currency; headcount x salary is the org's personnel budget line.

departments.name: Civil Registry
departments.description: Population register, identity records, and migration of existing citizens into the realm.

departments.name: Justice
departments.description: Courts, dispute resolution, and enforcement oversight.

departments.name: Defense
departments.description: Civil protection, emergency response, and public security.

departments.name: Social Security
departments.description: Welfare benefits, pensions, social support, and redistribution programs.

departments.name: Infrastructure
departments.description: Land zones, public works, and the geographic organization of quarters.

departments.name: Economy
departments.description: Public finances, treasury, budgets, and (future) tax declarations and collection.

departments.name: Administration
departments.description: Realm operations, role management, and lifecycle administration.
